stories.title: U.S. trade chief sees progress in Canada talks, raises China concerns
stories.summary: OTTAWA — U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer says Washington and Ottawa are making progress toward a trade agreement, but Canada's growing trade relationship with China remains a concern.
